title: Retrospective analysis of the efficacy, safety, and technical parameters of middle meningeal artery embolization using MagicGlue
summary: The study aims to retrospectively assess how the liquid embolic agent N-hexyl-cyanoacrylate (NHCA) performs compared to other liquid embolic materials. Technical aspects of the procedure will be evaluated, such as the radiographic visibility of NHCA compared to other substances. In addition, the study will examine whether patients who underwent surgery for chronic subdural hematoma required repeat operations more frequently if they did not receive middle meningeal artery embolization, compared with those who were treated with NHCA.

interventions.name: Patients who underwent middle meningeal artery embolization using N-hexyl-cyanoacrylate (NHCA)

Patients who
a) did not undergo MMA embolization but received burr-hole trepanation or craniotomy for cSDH, or
b) underwent MMA embolization using an EVOH-based liquid embolic agent.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
MMA embolization performed with Magic Glue or Squid, or burr-hole trepanation for cSDH performed before the introduction of MMA embolization at the University Hospital Bonn (UKB).
Exclusion criteria:
a) missing 90-day follow-up;
b) missing or inadequate imaging documentation
